problem: Planar selection queried a 3D nearest path first, so a tilted elevated LINE or IMAGE could be missed even when its projection passed under the cursor.
implementation: Share XY segment and infinite-line projection in geo::Vector, interpolate source Z, and route only planar LINE and IMAGE picking through those nonvirtual methods. Existing 3D path queries are unchanged.
validation: The generated tilted LINE and IMAGE viewer controls failed before their respective fixes.

87 focused viewer, vector, image, builder and layer tests pass, including selected tilted-line and image selection/snap, planar and 3D distinction, bounded versus infinite projection, XY-degenerate vectors and ordinary 2D controls.
limits: A line or image edge projected to one XY point has ambiguous depth; this implementation deterministically uses the starting elevation.
Native GUI, other entity types, extreme numeric magnitudes and broader 3D interaction remain unqualified.
